in_arabic.name: Badi
in_arabic.long_meaning: Badi هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'bad', meaning 'to put on a high pedestal, to exalt, to glorify'. In Islamic context, the name Badi represents one who is highly esteemed, revered, and respected.
